claim: In the guide's example of an interface endpoint for Amazon CloudWatch with endpoint network interfaces in two Availability Zones, a resource that accesses CloudWatch by its public endpoint is resolved to a healthy endpoint network interface selected with the round robin algorithm.

evidence.quote: The following diagram shows a VPC endpoint for Amazon CloudWatch with endpoint network interfaces in two Availability Zones. When any resource in any subnet in the VPC accesses Amazon CloudWatch by using its public endpoint, we select a healthy endpoint network interface, using the round robin algorithm to alternate between them. We then resolve the traffic to the IP address of the selected endpoint network interface.
